name: OmniFocus
description: OmniFocus is a personal task-management app for organizing inbox items, projects, folders, tags, forecasts, perspectives, reviews, and recurring work across Apple devices and the web.
agentUseSummary: OmniFocus cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its documented automation API, plug-ins, script URLs, Shortcuts, and AppleScript execute inside an installed local app with explicit script security, while Relay Marketplace does not currently ship that separate device-local authority.

blocked.label: Connect OmniFocus
blocked.description: Relay does not present Omni account or sync credentials as an API connection and does not silently substitute an installed Mac, iPhone, or iPad app for Railway authority.

blocked.label: Run Omni Automation
blocked.description: Omni Automation JavaScript, plug-ins, script URLs, Shortcuts, and AppleScript execute in a local OmniFocus app and require app configuration or user script approval that Relay cannot currently mount.

blocked.label: Access private OmniFocus data
blocked.description: Relay does not automate OmniFocus for the Web, reuse browser or Omni account sessions, ask for sync credentials, inspect local databases, call private web services, or install arbitrary plug-ins.

blocked.label: Change OmniFocus content
blocked.description: Creating, editing, completing, moving, duplicating, deleting, or otherwise changing tasks, projects, folders, tags, perspectives, attachments, and database content remains unavailable until Relay ships explicit local execution and approval boundaries.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay ships a separately disclosed, user-authorized device-local OmniFocus connector using the supported automation runtime.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not mount arbitrary OmniFocus plug-ins or silently bridge OpenClaw to a device-local Omni Automation runtime.
Relay does not mount arbitrary OmniFocus plug-ins or silently bridge Hermes to a device-local Omni Automation runtime.

providerSetup.blocker: The distributable OmniFocus automation contract is an in-app JavaScript, plug-in, URL, Shortcuts, or Mac AppleScript surface with local installation and script-security controls. Relay's current Marketplace runtime intentionally excludes local-app command execution and has no documented public OmniFocus cloud API to use as Railway authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Omni account credentials, automate the web app, inspect a local database, install a plug-in, or show Connect. Reconsider after Relay ships a separately disclosed Mac/iPhone local-connection architecture with app presence, user script authorization, pinned reviewed operations, per-action approval, result redaction, audit, and no cloud fallback.

evidence.supports: Omni documents built-in Omni Automation for OmniFocus, in-app automation controls, plug-ins, an API reference, and script-security configuration for remote scripts.
Omni documents that external script URLs must be enabled in the installed app and that individual scripts require approval that can later be reset.
Omni documents user-created JavaScript plug-ins, local editing and installation, an installation security dialog, and device or iCloud Drive plug-in locations.
Omni describes OmniFocus for the Web as a paid companion requiring an OmniFocus database and Omni account login, not a public third-party developer API.
